name: U-3PO
description: U-3PO was a 3PO-series protocol droid who served the Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps. After Imperial agents altered his programming, the droid became an unwitting spy in the royal court of the planet Alderaan, and was assigned to the CR90 corvette Tantive IV in 1 BBY. After the corvette fled from the Battle of Scarif carrying the plans to the Death Star superweapon, the Empire used U-3PO to track the vessel to the Tatoo system.
